explanation: It is Latin exempli gratia, for the sake of example. Its cousin i.e. is id est, that is, which introduces a restatement rather than examples.

claims.text: 'e.g.' stands for Latin exempli gratia, 'for the sake of example', and is used to mean 'for example'.
'That is' is i.e. (id est), 'and so on' is etc. (et cetera) and 'note well' is NB (nota bene).
i.e. introduces a restatement or clarification, while e.g. introduces examples.
